newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 30.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 30.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Monday:
* Composite index of blue chips ends up 3.32 points or 0.31 percent to 1,070.06 on Friday. Dealers say end-of-the-month sprucing of portfolios may lift index further on Monday.
* Dow Jones index ends up 33.47 points to 7,687.72 on Friday, for loss of 108.79 for week.
* Ringgit at 2.5239/49 at 0455 GMT on Friday versus 2.5207/17 at Kuala Lumpur close on Thursday.
* Closure of Hong Kong stock market from Monday through Wednesday for handover observances may temper activity in Kuala Lumpur.
* Malaysia's acting Prime Minister and Finance Minister Anwar Ibrahim on Friday announces revisions in guidelines for the issue of securities.

For listing of subsidiary company, treshold of after-tax profits contributed by the unit raised to 50 percent from 35 percent. Applicants for Second Board listing must provide profit guarantee supported by bank guarantee, instead of either a profit guarantee or moratorium on disposal of shares.
Anwar said measures were part of continuing effort to liberalise Malaysia's capital markets.
